title: Video Production and Shoots in Charleston, SC
metaTitle: Video Production and Shoots in Charleston, SC | TDM
metaDescription: Video production for Charleston businesses: concept, scripting, shoot planning and post-production for hotels, venues, restaurants, clinics and employers.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) produces video for Charleston businesses from concept to finished file: treatment, script, casting, direction, filming and post-production. Here is how the work is divided. TDM's team in the United States directs and films in Charleston, at your hotel, venue, kitchen or workplace. The footage is then sent to our operations office in Lahore, where editors cut, grade and caption it. Concept, script and schedule are settled with you before the filming day.

sections.heading: What Charleston businesses film, and why
paragraphs: Charleston is sold through its looks. A boutique hotel, a courtyard restaurant, a wedding venue under live oaks or a harbor cruise is chosen by someone in another state who has only a screen to judge by. Video does that persuading better than photographs, and it has to be filmed here.

Other local subjects are less scenic and just as useful. Employers recruiting for the aircraft, van and car plants want to show the work and the people. Warehouses and freight companies around the port want to show capacity to shippers who will never tour the site. Hospitals and private practices want patients to meet a doctor before the appointment.

sections.heading: From brief to finished video
paragraphs: TDM also runs ads and social media, so we plan each shoot from the list of places the footage will appear.
bullets: A written treatment and script, approved by you before anything is booked.
Storyboard and shot list, including alternative opening shots for ad testing.
Pre-production: talent, locations, props, wardrobe and a timed schedule.
The shoot, run against the approved plan.
Editing, grading, sound and captions at our operations office in Lahore, working from the director's notes.
Finished videos in each platform's format, not a folder of raw clips.

sections.heading: Practical points about filming in Charleston
paragraphs: Light and crowds decide the schedule downtown. Early morning gives empty streets and soft light on Rainbow Row and the Battery; by mid-morning there are carriages, tour groups and delivery trucks in every frame. Summer heat is hard on talent and equipment, and afternoon thunderstorms are routine, so outdoor days need a backup.

Permissions need early attention. Commercial filming on city streets, in parks and on the beaches can require a permit from the relevant municipality, and historic houses, plantations and gardens set their own terms and fees. Drone use is restricted near the airport and the air base in North Charleston and around port facilities. Inside a plant or a terminal, expect safety inductions and areas that cannot be shown. In a clinic, patient consent comes first. We raise all of this during pre-production so that the filming day is spent filming.

sections.heading: Before you commit to a production
paragraphs: Ask who will be on location and who directs them. Ask who obtains permits and signed releases. Ask what you will own at the end.

presence: A member of our team is based in South Carolina, outside Charleston. Filming in the city is done by TDM's US-based team, and every video is finished by our editors at the operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: Who films a TDM shoot in Charleston?
faqs.a: Our own US-based team directs and films it on location in the city. We are a marketing agency, so the same people plan the footage around your ads and social channels, and the edit is completed at our operations office in Lahore.

faqs.q: Do I need a permit to film a commercial in downtown Charleston?
faqs.a: Often, yes, when filming on public streets, in parks or on beaches. Rules differ between the City of Charleston and the neighbouring towns and islands. Permissions are confirmed during pre-production.

faqs.q: Can you film our products as well as our premises?
faqs.a: Yes. Product demonstrations and detail shots can be filmed on the same day as a venue or workplace shoot, or planned as a session of their own. Tell us which products matter most so they are written into the schedule.

faqs.q: What does a video shoot in Charleston cost?
faqs.a: The price depends on the concept, locations, talent, permits and the number of finished videos. We quote after a free consultation, when the brief is settled.

faqs.q: How far ahead should we plan a shoot?
faqs.a: It depends on the brief, the permissions needed and the season you want on screen. Dates for pre-production, filming and editing are fixed in a plan agreed with you.
